sources.title: Probing quantum mechanics with nanoparticle matter-wave interferometry
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the current high-mass matter-wave pressure test against any R004 realization that makes classicality an unavoidable function of object mass, atom count, or size alone.
sources.not_claimed: The experiment does not test Enterprise Math in general; an R004 realization must first map its finite dynamics to an unavoidable interference observable.

sources.title: Quantum nature of the big bang: An analytical and numerical investigation
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a distinct quantum-cosmology example in which the classical big-bang singularity is replaced by nonclassical quantum-geometry dynamics, preventing R004 from claiming novelty merely for abandoning a classical singular point.
sources.not_claimed: Loop quantum cosmology, quantum geometry, and the big-bounce result are prior work and are not Enterprise Math results.

sources.title: Environment as a witness: Selective proliferation of information and emergence of objectivity in a quantum universe
sources.enterprise_use: Provides prior environment-as-witness and redundant-recording structure against which R004's finite environment-record premodel must be compared; R004 does not equate finite record overlap with quantum Darwinism.
sources.not_claimed: Decoherence, pointer observables, environment-as-witness, and quantum Darwinism are established prior work.

sources.title: Strong Functional Representation Lemma and Applications to Coding Theorems
sources.enterprise_use: Provides a primary-source functional-representation neighbor for R004's finite rational latent-seed and response-table no-go: stochastic outputs may be represented as functions of inputs together with independent auxiliary randomness. R004 only uses a much simpler finite-rational specialization and does not claim the representation principle as new.
sources.not_claimed: The Strong Functional Representation Lemma, channel simulation, and auxiliary-randomness representation are prior work; R004 does not claim its finite denominator-clearing specialization as a new general representation theorem.

sources.title: A Causal Calculus for Statistical Research
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the formal intervention/structural-equation prior-art boundary for R004's adaptive-intervention no-go. R004's result says that adding a finite intervention syntax to finite rational classical kernels still permits a finite pre-sampled response-table completion unless further structural restrictions are imposed.
sources.not_claimed: Causal conditioning, intervention semantics, do-calculus, and structural-equation semantics are established prior work and are not Enterprise Math results.
